turns.question: What was our cart abandonment rate between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no cart abandonment rate metric; the closest metrics are the cart-to-checkout rate, cart sessions and checkout sessions, and the cart-to-checkout rate (share of site sessions with an add to cart that checked out on the add to cart's day or the day after) was 0.4 (40 %) over 5 cart sessions from 20 September to 3 October 2026. Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
